$comment: secret-guard config. Globs match normalized absolute paths (forward slashes). allowPathPatterns wins over both block lists. blockedPathPatterns applies to every tool (reads, probes, shell); writeBlockedPathPatterns applies to write/edit only. Pragmatic preset: .env, .env.*, *.pem, *.p12, *.pfx are NOT blocked, because reading them is normal work and the redaction dictionary covers their values once those keys are in the vault.
